channel.title: Rolling Stone India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Rolling Stone India (rollingstoneindia.com)

item.title: Chance the Rapper Awarded $35 in Exploitation Countersuit Against Former Manager
item.description: Chance the Rapper has reached the end of a five-year legal battle with his former manager, Pat Corcoran.

item.title: Love ‘The Pitt’? Check Out ‘Late Shift’
item.description: Most of us dread the thought of entering the broken-down labyrinth that is the American health care system, yet we’ll happily watch hours of hyper-competent hospital employees bark jargon and scramble to save lives on TV.

item.title: J. Cole Calls Drake Backlash a ‘Whole Campaign,’ Says He’s ‘Disgusted’
item.description: J. Cole is speaking candidly about the fallout from the explosive feud between Drake and Kendrick Lamar, calling out what he views as opportunistic criticism disguised as commentary.

item.title: Watch Jennie Perform Tame Impala’s ‘Dracula’ in Hong Kong
item.description: Jennie performed “Dracula” for the first time live at Hong Kong’s Complex Live music festival on Sunday night.

item.title: Hybe India Announces Hunt for 'The Next Generation of Artists from India'
item.description: Hybe India is officially kicking off a massive talent search through auditions across the country, from Mumbai to Guwahati.

item.title: New Music: Masrat Un Nissa, Janisht Joshi, Rashmeet Kaur and More
item.description: From indie band Champak’s intriguing debut release to pop artist Kiara Chettri’s latest, we round up the best new music

item.title: Symphony of Santoor Review: Indian Classical Meets Orchestra
item.description: Backed by a 35-piece chamber orchestra, Pandit Rahul Shivkumar Sharma repositions the santoor at the centre of a fusion experiment

item.title: Inside The Making of Aditya Rikhari and Kutle Khans ‘Ae Ajnabee’
item.description: Aditya Rikhari, Kutle Khan and Ravator lead with longing lyrics and rock energy on Coke Studio Bharat’s new song “Ae Ajnabee.”

item.title: 'Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special' Takeaways
item.description: Miley Cyrus celebrated the 20th anniversary of the show that introduced her to the world in a nostalgic special

item.title: Jay-Z Weighs in on Drake-Kendrick Feud
item.description: Hov argues that rap battles may no longer serve hip-hop’s growth in a new interview with GQ

item.title: Netflix's Red Hot Chili Peppers Documentary Uses AI to Voice Hillel Slovak
item.description: Netflix’s new documentary about the early days of the Red Hot Chili Peppers and the influence of their founding guitarist, Hillel Slovak, uses an AI voiceover of the late musician reading through his personal journals.

item.title: Chris Cornell's Daughter: How Mental Health Treatment Saved My Life
item.description: Lily Cornell Silver, daughter of the late Soundgarden frontman Chris Cornell, grew up feeling shy about making her own music.

item.title: A Gen Z Take on Russell Peters’ Relax World Tour Show
item.description: Packed with phallic witticisms and dated NRI references, Peters’ ninety-minute set left me questioning the semantics of “offensive” jokes

item.title: Netflix and Warner Music Group Strike Multi-Year Deal for Artist Documentaries
item.description: Netflix and Warner Music Group have announced an exclusive multi-year partnership to develop non-fiction docu-series and full-length films

item.title: ThirumaLi Is Redefining Nostalgia in Malayalam Hip-Hop
item.description: Rapping since 2013 and making it his career by 2018, ThirumaLi is among the few who has led Malayalam hip-hop to the globally-recognized level it’s reached now
